title: Unisex Heavyweight Slim Fit T-Shirt
descriptionHtml:
Elevate your daily rotation with the Unisex Heavyweight Slim Fit Crewneck T-Shirt. Crafted from premium knit cotton, this T-Shirt offers a substantial feel and a sleek H-Line silhouette. Its slim fit and classic crewneck design provide a modern, minimalist aesthetic, perfect for a refined casual lineup. The short sleeve and straight hem finish ensure a clean, versatile look. Designed for everyday comfort and style, this piece is also optimized for custom DTG and DTF decoration, making it an ideal base for unique brand expressions. A foundational garment for any Men's wardrobe, blending quality with understated cool.

Features

- Fit: Slim-fit
- Neckline: Round Neck / O-Neck
- Sleeve Style: Regular Sleeve
- Sleeve Length: Short Sleeve
- Season: Summer
- Style: Basics / Casual / Sporty

Care Instructions

- Machine wash at 30°C (gentle cycle)
- Do not bleach
- Tumble dry low
- Iron at low temperature, avoid ironing on print
- Do not dry clean

Fabric

- Material: 90% cotton, 10% spandex
- Fabric Weight: 280 gsm (8.3 oz)
- Thickness: Thin
- Breathability: Moderate

title: Curved Panel Raglan Hoodie
descriptionHtml:
Tapstitch's Curved Panel Raglan Hoodie defines modern utility with sleek curved seams and hidden side zip pockets. Designed with ergonomic raglan sleeves and a unique curved back yoke, this pullover offers a sophisticated, structured silhouette. The clean, drawstring-free hood adds to its minimalist appeal. Serving as a high-end canvas for Custom Streetwear, this item is optimized for Custom DTG and DTF printing, ensuring a premium finish for your Dropshipping and Print-on-Demand collections.

Features

- Effects: Zipper / Pocket / Patchwork
- Fit: Oversized
- Neckline: Hooded
- Sleeve Style: Raglan Sleeve
- Sleeve Length: Long Sleeve
- Season: Spring / Autumn / Winter
- Style: Basics / Casual / Sporty / Street

title: Men’s Vintage Wash Barrel Leg Jeans
descriptionHtml:
Elevate your daily rotation with these Men's barrel leg jeans, engineered from a heavy cotton blend woven fabric for structured durability. Featuring a distinctive loose fit that curves outward before tapering to a straight hem, this pair showcases a vintage wash and reverse wash treatment with crinkled details. A mid rise waistline, zip fly closure, and classic slash pockets complete the design, while the gradient washed effect adds a modern edge. Perfect for skateboarding, street dance, or everyday casual wear, these full length pants offer a bold silhouette that serves as a versatile custom base.

Features

- Effects: Washed

- Fit: Loose

- Season: Spring

- Style: Basics / Casual / Street / Vintage

Care Instructions

- Machine wash at 30°C (gentle cycle)

- Do not bleach

- Tumble dry low

- Iron at low temperature, avoid ironing on print

- Do not dry clean

Fabric

- Material: 80% cotton, 14% regenerated cellulose, 6% polyester

- Fabric Weight: 450 gsm (13.3 oz)

- Thickness: Thick

- Breathability: Moderate
